name: Kineticist
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low to moderate Perception; high Nature, moderate Athletics; high Con; high AC; high to extreme Fortitude, high Reflex, low Will; moderate HP; high accuracy with blasts and moderate damage; high to extreme spell DC (standing in for class DC). Abilities: Two-action Elemental Blast (use Strikes for one-action Elemental Blast, bludgeoning or piercing damage, 30 feet), Channel Elements, armor of earth (counted in its AC), enemies moving away from it within its kinetic aura treat the ground as difficult terrain, Earth impulse feats. Junctions: pick one, maybe two, of the element's gate junctions (impulse, aura, critical blast, elemental resistance, skill) for the stat block rather than stacking them all; more is a GM's option for a tougher kineticist

notes.defense: High AC; high to extreme Fortitude, high Reflex, low Will; moderate HP.
notes.offense: High attack bonus with blasts (its spell attack) and moderate damage.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC, standing in for its class DC: its impulses work like spells, but it has no spellcasting.

Junctions: pick one, maybe two, of the element's gate junctions (impulse, aura, critical blast, elemental resistance, skill) for the stat block rather than stacking them all; more is a GM's option for a tougher kineticist.
